import Part
from FreeCAD import Vector

shell_dir = "/home/al-pauna/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/GoodmanHPCtrl/shell/"

# Load all 4 shells
bot_orig = Part.read\(shell_dir + "3DShell_GoodmanHPv3_B_3mm.step"\)
top_orig = Part.read\(shell_dir + "3DShell_GoodmanHPv3_T_3mm_TC.step"\)
bot_new = Part.read\(shell_dir + "3DShell_GoodmanHPv3_B_3.5mm_flipped.step"\)
top_new = Part.read\(shell_dir + "3DShell_GoodmanHPv3_T_3.5mm_TC_flipped.step"\)

OX_L = -98.262; IX_L = -95.262; IX_R = 1.917; OX_R = 4.917
OY_F = -32.48;  IY_F = -29.48;  IY_B = 94.12;  OY_B = 97.12
MX_L = -96.762; MX_R = 3.417; MY_F = -30.98; MY_B = 95.62

# The screw holes should be in the wall at the mating zone
# Scan through the mating zone with fine probes to find cylindrical holes

# Check original bottom shell at Z=32.5 \(middle of groove/tongue overlap\)
# Scan along each wall looking for holes
print\("=== ORIGINAL BOTTOM SHELL ==="\)
print\("Scanning walls at Z=32.5 \(mating zone midpoint\)..."\)

# Left wall: probe in Y direction at wall midpoint X
for y_10 in range\(int\(IY_F*10\), int\(IY_B*10\), 5\):  # 0.5mm steps
    y = y_10 / 10.0
    # Probe through the wall in X direction
    line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(OX_L-5, y, 32.5\), Vector\(IX_L+5, y, 32.5\)\)
    sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
    if sec.Vertexes:
        xs = sorted\([v.X for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
        # Look for >2 intersections \(indicates a hole in the wall\)
        if len\(xs\) > 2:
            print\(f"  Left wall Y={y:.1f}: {len\(xs\)} hits X={[f'{x:.2f}' for x in xs]}"\)

# Right wall
for y_10 in range\(int\(IY_F*10\), int\(IY_B*10\), 5\):
    y = y_10 / 10.0
    line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(IX_R-5, y, 32.5\), Vector\(OX_R+5, y, 32.5\)\)
    sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
    if sec.Vertexes:
        xs = sorted\([v.X for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
        if len\(xs\) > 2:
            print\(f"  Right wall Y={y:.1f}: {len\(xs\)} hits X={[f'{x:.2f}' for x in xs]}"\)

# Front wall
for x_10 in range\(int\(IX_L*10\), int\(IX_R*10\), 5\):
    x = x_10 / 10.0
    line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(x, OY_F-5, 32.5\), Vector\(x, IY_F+5, 32.5\)\)
    sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
    if sec.Vertexes:
        ys = sorted\([v.Y for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
        if len\(ys\) > 2:
            print\(f"  Front wall X={x:.1f}: {len\(ys\)} hits Y={[f'{y:.2f}' for y in ys]}"\)

# Back wall
for x_10 in range\(int\(IX_L*10\), int\(IX_R*10\), 5\):
    x = x_10 / 10.0
    line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(x, IY_B-5, 32.5\), Vector\(x, OY_B+5, 32.5\)\)
    sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
    if sec.Vertexes:
        ys = sorted\([v.Y for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
        if len\(ys\) > 2:
            print\(f"  Back wall X={x:.1f}: {len\(ys\)} hits Y={[f'{y:.2f}' for y in ys]}"\)

# Also scan at multiple Z levels to find the screw hole Z extent
print\("\\n=== Scanning multiple Z levels for screw holes ==="\)
for z_10 in range\(280, 355, 5\):
    z = z_10 / 10.0
    # Check left wall at mid-Y
    y_mid = \(OY_F + OY_B\) / 2
    line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(OX_L-5, y_mid, z\), Vector\(IX_L+5, y_mid, z\)\)
    sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
    if sec.Vertexes:
        xs = sorted\([v.X for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
        if len\(xs\) > 2:
            print\(f"  Left wall Z={z:.1f}, Y={y_mid:.1f}: {len\(xs\)} hits X={[f'{x:.2f}' for x in xs]}"\)

# Maybe the screw holes are screw bosses/pillars, not wall holes
# Let's check for cylindrical features by scanning inside the cavity at the wall level
print\("\\n=== Looking for screw bosses/posts inside cavity ==="\)
# Scan Z=31-35 looking for solid material inside the cavity that shouldn't be wall
for z_10 in range\(310, 355, 5\):
    z = z_10 / 10.0
    # Scan across the cavity interior
    for y in range\(int\(IY_F\)+2, int\(IY_B\)-2, 10\):
        # Left side near inner wall
        line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(IX_L-2, y, z\), Vector\(IX_L+8, y, z\)\)
        sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
        if sec.Vertexes:
            xs = sorted\([v.X for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
            if len\(xs\) > 2:
                print\(f"  Left boss Z={z:.1f}, Y={y}: {len\(xs\)} hits X={[f'{x:.2f}' for x in xs]}"\)
        # Right side near inner wall
        line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(IX_R-8, y, z\), Vector\(IX_R+2, y, z\)\)
        sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
        if sec.Vertexes:
            xs = sorted\([v.X for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
            if len\(xs\) > 2:
                print\(f"  Right boss Z={z:.1f}, Y={y}: {len\(xs\)} hits X={[f'{x:.2f}' for x in xs]}"\)

# Check front/back walls too
    for x in range\(int\(IX_L\)+2, int\(IX_R\)-2, 10\):
        line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(x, IY_F-2, z\), Vector\(x, IY_F+8, z\)\)
        sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
        if sec.Vertexes:
            ys = sorted\([v.Y for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
            if len\(ys\) > 2:
                print\(f"  Front boss Z={z:.1f}, X={x}: {len\(ys\)} hits Y={[f'{y:.2f}' for y in ys]}"\)
        line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(x, IY_B-8, z\), Vector\(x, IY_B+2, z\)\)
        sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
        if sec.Vertexes:
            ys = sorted\([v.Y for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
            if len\(ys\) > 2:
                print\(f"  Back boss Z={z:.1f}, X={x}: {len\(ys\)} hits Y={[f'{y:.2f}' for y in ys]}"\)

# Also look for screw holes as through-holes in the wall \(probe through wall at mating zone\)
print\("\\n=== Scanning for through-holes in walls \(Z-direction probes\) ==="\)
# At the mating zone, probe vertically through the wall to find holes
# Left wall
wall_mid_x = \(OX_L + IX_L\) / 2
for y in range\(int\(IY_F\)+1, int\(IY_B\), 2\):
    line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(wall_mid_x, y, 28\), Vector\(wall_mid_x, y, 36\)\)
    sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
    if sec.Vertexes:
        zs = sorted\([v.Z for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
        # More than 2 Z hits = there's a hole 
        if len\(zs\) > 2:
            print\(f"  Left wall X={wall_mid_x:.2f}, Y={y}: {len\(zs\)} Z hits = {[f'{z:.2f}' for z in zs]}"\)

# Right wall
wall_mid_x = \(OX_R + IX_R\) / 2
for y in range\(int\(IY_F\)+1, int\(IY_B\), 2\):
    line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(wall_mid_x, y, 28\), Vector\(wall_mid_x, y, 36\)\)
    sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
    if sec.Vertexes:
        zs = sorted\([v.Z for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
        if len\(zs\) > 2:
            print\(f"  Right wall X={wall_mid_x:.2f}, Y={y}: {len\(zs\)} Z hits = {[f'{z:.2f}' for z in zs]}"\)

# Front wall
wall_mid_y = \(OY_F + IY_F\) / 2
for x in range\(int\(IX_L\)+1, int\(IX_R\), 2\):
    line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(x, wall_mid_y, 28\), Vector\(x, wall_mid_y, 36\)\)
    sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
    if sec.Vertexes:
        zs = sorted\([v.Z for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
        if len\(zs\) > 2:
            print\(f"  Front wall X={x}, Y={wall_mid_y:.2f}: {len\(zs\)} Z hits = {[f'{z:.2f}' for z in zs]}"\)

# Back wall
wall_mid_y = \(OY_B + IY_B\) / 2
for x in range\(int\(IX_L\)+1, int\(IX_R\), 2\):
    line = Part.makeLine\(Vector\(x, wall_mid_y, 28\), Vector\(x, wall_mid_y, 36\)\)
    sec = bot_orig.section\(line\)
    if sec.Vertexes:
        zs = sorted\([v.Z for v in sec.Vertexes]\)
        if len\(zs\) > 2:
            print\(f"  Back wall X={x}, Y={wall_mid_y:.2f}: {len\(zs\)} Z hits = {[f'{z:.2f}' for z in zs]}"\)

# Let's also check by cross-sectioning at the screw boss height
print\("\\n=== Cross-section at Z=32.5 looking for anything unusual ==="\)
plane = Part.makePlane\(300, 300, Vector\(-200, -200, 32.5\), Vector\(0, 0, 1\)\)
sec = bot_orig.section\(plane\)
sbb = sec.BoundBox
print\(f"Bottom orig Z=32.5: X[{sbb.XMin:.2f},{sbb.XMax:.2f}] Y[{sbb.YMin:.2f},{sbb.YMax:.2f}] edges={len\(sec.Edges\)}"\)

sec = top_orig.section\(plane\)
sbb = sec.BoundBox
print\(f"Top orig Z=32.5: X[{sbb.XMin:.2f},{sbb.XMax:.2f}] Y[{sbb.YMin:.2f},{sbb.YMax:.2f}] edges={len\(sec.Edges\)}"\)

# Maybe the screw holes are on the screw bosses that come from the original EasyEDA export
# Let's look at the bounding boxes of internal features
print\("\\n=== Extracting internal features via common\(\) ==="\)
# Extract features inside the cavity
cavity = Part.makeBox\(IX_R - IX_L + 4, IY_B - IY_F + 4, 40,
                      Vector\(IX_L - 2, IY_F - 2, 0\)\)
features = bot_orig.common\(cavity\)
if features.Volume > 10:
    fbb = features.BoundBox
    print\(f"Bottom internal features: vol={features.Volume:.0f} X[{fbb.XMin:.2f},{fbb.XMax:.2f}] Y[{fbb.YMin:.2f},{fbb.YMax:.2f}] Z[{fbb.ZMin:.2f},{fbb.ZMax:.2f}]"\)
    # Cross-section the features
    for z_10 in range\(300, 360, 5\):
        z = z_10 / 10.0
        plane = Part.makePlane\(300, 300, Vector\(-200, -200, z\), Vector\(0, 0, 1\)\)
        sec = features.section\(plane\)
        if sec.Edges:
            sbb = sec.BoundBox
            print\(f"  Z={z:.1f}: X[{sbb.XMin:.2f},{sbb.XMax:.2f}] Y[{sbb.YMin:.2f},{sbb.YMax:.2f}] edges={len\(sec.Edges\)}"\)

features_top = top_orig.common\(cavity\)
if features_top.Volume > 10:
    fbb = features_top.BoundBox
    print\(f"Top internal features: vol={features_top.Volume:.0f} X[{fbb.XMin:.2f},{fbb.XMax:.2f}] Y[{fbb.YMin:.2f},{fbb.YMax:.2f}] Z[{fbb.ZMin:.2f},{fbb.ZMax:.2f}]"\)
PYEOF)
